and [[Instituto Atlético Central Córdoba|Instituto (C)]] (qualified from [[2000–01 Primera B Nacional]]) respectively,[https://www.lavoz.com.ar/deportes/futbol/instituto-con-buenas-malas-promociones-revalidas/ Instituto con buenas y malas] on ''La Voz'' in a [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] series. Although the two playoff series ended 1–1 on aggregate, Argentinos and Belgrano remained in the top division due to rules stated that in cases like those, teams in Primera División would be declared winners (sporting advantage).[https://web.archive.org/web/20211023183050/https://www.lavoz.com.ar/deportes/futbol/julio-mugnaini-la-historia-de-un-gol-historico-en-belgrano-quilmes-y-un-dia-del-padre-especia/ Julio Mugnaini, la historia de un gol histórico], La Voz"Argentina: 1ra.
